Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-353#declare-git-test-state-through-makeme (plan 642), revision cc9f99288e51ca62dc4cc1a217c0919ddce1e6c3

Verdict: Caught. The maintained assertion `expect(input).toContain(`Landed run ${base} → ${tree}`)` (dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-follow-up-file-admission.spec.ts:87, test "a file follow-up on a launch's landed run admits and names its comparison") failed on independently observed wrong behavior: admission still launched the host, but the launched instruction named the wrong comparison. Claim limited to this landed-run, line-2 new-side path.

Next proof action: none for this promise; the maintained assertion holds against a wrong-endpoint naming fault.

Promise: the HTTP action admits a landed-run file follow-up and names that comparison (base → delivered tip) in the launched instruction (seed key example). Caller's suggested promise, fault and command were validated and reused.

Fault: dashboard/server/followUpFileAdmission.ts, admitFollowUpFile's returned facts — `baseline: file.baseline` changed to `baseline: file.completion !== undefined ? file.baseline : file.tree` (landed runs name the tip twice). Admission checks (admitHistoricalReviewedFile, admitLineOnSide) still used the real base, so admission succeeded. The text is rendered by dashboard/src/followUpContext.ts fileContextItems ("Comparison: Landed run <baseline> → <tree>"). Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Wrong behavior independently observed in the received host argv: "- Comparison: Landed run 4e5755ff… → 4e5755ff…" versus expected "Landed run e90576ea… → 4e5755ff…" (base → delivered).
- Restoration: edit reverted by EXIT trap (`git checkout --`); scratch `git status --porcelain` empty at HEAD cc9f99288; restored rerun 5/5 passed (runner and strict). Scratch worktree then removed (`git worktree remove`).
